summary: Common WebRTC plumbing improved: Firefox now fully supports extmap-allow-mixed (an RTP/RTCP header extension rule that allows mixing one-byte and two-byte extension formats), which makes header-extension handling more standards-compliant. The WebRTC port allowlist was exposed as a shared helper so different parts of the code use the same policy, and a small off-by-one bug in video stamping was fixed. Together these changes improve interoperability and internal correctness.
